t: An open-source smartwatch for recording ECG, heart rate, and other body signals.
steps: Order the watch from Crowd Supply or the ProtoCentral store.
Charge it over USB-C and fit a 22 mm strap.
Install the HealthyPi Move companion app on your phone.
Pair the watch over Bluetooth and sync the clock.
Take your first ECG by placing a finger on the bezel electrode.
Open the ProtoCentral docs and read the sensor guides.
To change the firmware, install VS Code with the nRF Connect SDK and build the Zephyr project.
meta: Open Board. From $339. A few stores.
